title: Two Hundred and Six
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生命科学）　|　核心词汇：bone　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to set ① a bone she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② bone, meaning the tissue and not the skeleton, was two hundred and six of them and was carried by whoever came last; a bone, she said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bone in that box had the same label, and the ④ bone at the front, meaning the one the surgeon held and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. A bone, my grandmother said, is nine parts mineral and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the mineral is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bone was the whole of the structure, meaning the frame it made and not the tissue. The ⑥ bone, meaning the structure and not any of that, is the only thing in a body that everybody leans on and nobody questions; a bone, he said, is either something you set or the only word that means both a tissue and a frame. She said the frame is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ bone had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the mineral. The ⑧ bone of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was two hundred and six of them and eleven years of counting; a bone, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bone I remember is the one at the front, which was drawn in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ bone, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being carried; every bone, she said, is a frame that has agreed to look like a tissue. She said the frame was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 骨（指骨组织本身，与骨架相对）
C. 固定搭配：set a bone 接骨、把骨头复位
D. n. 骨（指盒子里每一块）
E. n. 骨（指前面那一块）
F. n. 骨架；结构（抽象：与骨组织相对）
G. n. 骨架（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 要害；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bone she could not name
The bone, meaning the tissue and not the skeleton
bone was the whole of the structure
the bone had become a photograph in a report
The bone of the whole thing
A bone, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: set a bone 意为“接骨、把骨头复位”，1954 年母亲被派去接一块她叫不出名字的骨头。
bone 意为“骨”，指骨组织本身而不是骨架，一共二百零六块，由最后走的人拿着。
bone 指盒子里每一块骨，每一块都是同一个标签。
bone 指前面那一块（外科医生拿着的那一块），是唯一有人认真数过的。
bone 意为“骨架、结构”，与骨组织相对，父亲说 bone 就是那副结构的全部。
bone 为抽象用法，指骨架这件事本身，是身体里人人都倚靠、却没人质疑的东西。
bone 意为“骨、骨头”，到 1970 年这块 bone 成了报告里的一张照片。
bone 意为“要害、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事的要害是那二百零六块和十一年的清点。
bone 意为“骨头”，我记得的是前面那一块，1974 年被画下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bone 为抽象总称，祖母说骨头是唯一会因为被负重而变好的东西。
